{"headline":"Approve P1: extend the payments-to-general moves, delay general breaks and keep the outage message, at no extra cost. Predicted service level is 96.9% for 15:30-17:30 against the 80% target.","why":"The general queue is flooded with login_issue calls from incident INC-20261015-6270, where app and net banking login has failed since a certificate rotation. Login_issue calls are at 237 against 59.2 expected. Payments is 6 agents short (32 vs 38) because staff were already moved to cover general, not because of sickness. P1 keeps that cover going and adds more:
- 6 agents moved from payments to general 15:30-17:00, plus 4 more 16:00-17:00.
- General breaks from 15:30-16:15 delayed by 45 minutes.
- IVR outage message for login calls 16:00-17:00.
- IVR callback on general 15:30-17:00.

Predicted results for the window are general 94.8% and payments 99.0%, with abandons at 0.2%. Rest of day is predicted at 96.1%. P1 is the cheapest plan that meets the target with no policy violations.","trade_offs":["No action (P0) also meets target at 93.7%, but general is weaker at 88.8% and abandons are higher at 0.8% vs 0.2%. P1 improves customer experience for zero cost.","P2 adds chat deflection and cancels coaching for ₹552 and lifts general to 99.5%. The extra service is not needed to hit the target.","P3 adds overtime for ₹912 and reaches 99.7% overall. It costs the most, for a small gain over P1.","Payments is not put at risk: it holds 99.0% under P1 despite giving up up to 10 agents. Delayed breaks will put some strain on general agents."],"watch":"Track login_issue volume and the incident status. If the outage runs past 17:00, extend the IVR outage message and the agent moves. If the fix lands early, release the moved agents back to payments. If general falls toward 80%, consider P2's chat deflection (₹552)."}
